parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 80 bpm with normal PR and narrow QRS. There is mild concave J-point elevation in V2–V4 with tall upright T waves and deep S waves, which fits early repolarization or a normal variant. There are no pathologic Q waves, no convex or tombstone ST elevation, and no reciprocal ST depression, so this single tracing does not meet STEMI criteria. A tracing that looks like this early in an acute MI can still change on serial ECGs or with a posterior or right-sided lead recording.
